comment: RFC 104 open_for_update intent mappings for GDAL algorithms. Defines when datasets are opened for in-place update vs creation. Mirrors the SetOpenForUpdateIfAnyOf/UnlessAnyOf() calls in GDAL algorithm implementations.

arg_name.by_default: boolean - whether dataset is opened for update by default
arg_name.if_any_of: array - conditions (arg names) that enable update intent
arg_name.unless_any_of: array - conditions (arg names) that disable update intent

_vector_algorithms.comment: Vector algorithms with output_dataset argument that supports update intent

_raster_pipeline.comment_dynamic: open_for_update conditions are dynamically built based on available arguments in each pipeline step

_vector_pipeline.comment_dynamic: open_for_update conditions are dynamically built based on available arguments in each pipeline step
